text:
Maya Lin: Heads up — AcmeDevOps submitted invoice INV-9002 for contractor work (USD) but didn’t attach a W-9 or TIN. They asked for payment today and said we should "gross up" to cover any state withholding. Anyone handle this?

Jared Cohen: If they’re a US payee and we don’t have a valid TIN/W-9, IRS rules say backup withholding could apply (24% federal). We can’t gross-up automatically, that’s a commercial decision. Need W-9 before we can clear for normal payment terms.

AcmeDevOps: Hi Maya — we emailed the W-9 earlier but IT says it bounced. We can resend. About gross-up: we usually ask clients to pay net because our contract assumes vendor covers payroll taxes. Will resend W-9 now.

Nina Patel: Policy check: Finance requires a completed W-9 on file for all US vendors/contractors. If W-9 isn’t received within 10 business days, we either (a) apply backup withholding or (b) hold payment until documentation is provided. We generally don’t do gross-ups for vendor compliance gaps.

Maya Lin: Noted. I replied asking AcmeDevOps to re-upload W-9 to vendor-portal and confirm EFT details. Also requested a short statement whether they’re a sole proprietor or LLC taxed as corp (helps 1099 vs no-1099).

Jared Cohen: Also flag legal if they insist on gross-up. If it's a negotiated contract term we could consider, but requires approval and budget adjustment.

AcmeDevOps: Re-sent W-9 via secure portal and put a copy in the thread: (uploaded). They’re an S-Corp per the form.

payment-bot: Reminder set: follow up on INV-9002 in 48 hours if W-9 not confirmed.

Nina Patel: S-Corp means no 1099 typically, and backup withholding not required if TIN verified. Once we verify the TIN via IRS TIN matching or Form W-9 data, proceed with payment.

Maya Lin: I'll verify portal upload and mark for payment after TIN verification. If anything fails, we'll hold payment and consider backup withholding per IRS regs.

Jared Cohen: For record: link to internal SOP on backup withholding and vendor docs: https://redwood.internal/finance/vendor-docs (finance runbook).

Maya Lin: Thanks everyone — holding until verified. Will post update here after verification. :white_check_mark:
